name: @aise/desktop
description: AISE desktop adapter (PROD-020) — an Electron thin installed shell over the existing web application (ACR-004 desktop specialization), exposing desktop-appropriate capabilities (high-density review, keyboard shortcuts, optional local integration affordances) over the shared @aise/adapter-contract semantic objects. Desktop actions resolve to the same shared server/domain actions as the browser adapter; no domain fork, no local-filesystem authority.
